newsitem.title: USA: Heine Securities holds 6.5 pct Circon stake.
newsitem.headline: Heine Securities holds 6.5 pct Circon stake.

text.p: Heine Securities Corp said Friday it holds a 6.5 percent stake in Circon Corp or 814,700 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Heine said it bought the stake between August 5 and August 23 at prices ranging from $16.937 to $19.232 per share.
In view of the current offer by U.S. Surgical Corp, Heine said it urged Circon to "do all it can do to maximize shareholder value," according to the filing with the SEC.
The investment adviser, who bought the shares for investment, said it would continue to analyze the options available to Circon.
U.S. Surgical has extended its tender offer for Circon through September 30.
